description: Grant OPERATOR access to one of YOUR VPS to another person by email (they can power/reinstall/console/hostname/rdns, but NOT renew, cancel or change billing). Sends them an invitation with an accept link. Optional `expires_days` for time-limited access. Owner-only. Requires: token (owner).

email.description: Required. Email of the person who gets operator access, e.g. "admin@partner.org". They receive an invitation link.

expires_days.description: Optional. Access lifetime in days, integer 1–365. Default: no expiry (until revoked).

service_id.description: Optional. Service code as returned by list_vps/order_vps, e.g. "68J67T5" (a plain numeric id is also accepted).

name: delegate_service
title: Delegate service access
